comparison.order: Alternating before/after then after/before per independent trial; no compiler overlaps timing.

retention.rule: Every canonical case with paired-median after/before >=1.05, all TuplePack point/composition and initialization cases, substituted SeriesPack mutation-bound cases, both bimodal point controls on every profile, and full-active op0 tight-filter controls. The full 2205-row summary is reproducible from hashed raw worker results.
retention.threshold_limit: 5% selects records for compact retention; it is not an acceptance or significance threshold. Smaller losses and all prior candidate regressions remain in raw recovery and linked studies.

limits: Cases measure warm complete consumers, not cold memory, one-shot binding, mixed widths or owner publication.
Each ratio pairs one before and one after process. Independent trials are not confidence intervals. No pooled speedup is inferred.
The final SP guard closes the earlier AVX-512 substituted-write loss, but AVX2 all-row substituted writes still lose about 5–7%.
AVX-512 ordinary point cases have two sharply distinct timing regimes; record every sample rather than describe the median as uniform slowdown.
The AVX-512 TP two-field body write retains about15% loss; its exact linked hot loop and unchanged selected kernel work require placement/control interpretation, not dismissal.
Some filters retain losses, including one_stage controls; the ABI/codegen proof is not a throughput guarantee.
Earlier Bec/Stream diagnostics and settled Frame qualification use separately identified dependency-closed source epochs. Live Frame qualification belongs to its active owner.
